hooks.command: bash -c 'IN=$(cat); H=.claude/hooks/block-no-verify.sh; C=$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r ".cwd // empty"); R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -f "$R/$H" ] || R=$(git -C "$C" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$R/$H" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$R" bash "$R/$H"; elif [ -n "$C" ] && git -C "$C" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "block-no-verify: hook script unresolvable inside a repo — failing closed" >&2; exit 2; else echo "block-no-verify: cwd outside any git repo — nothing to guard" >&2; exit 0; fi'

bash -c 'IN=$(cat); H=.claude/hooks/block-release-please-files.sh; C=$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r ".cwd // empty"); R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -f "$R/$H" ] || R=$(git -C "$C" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$R/$H" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$R" bash "$R/$H"; elif [ -n "$C" ] && git -C "$C" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "block-release-please-files: hook script unresolvable inside a repo — failing closed" >&2; exit 2; else echo "block-release-please-files: cwd outside any git repo — nothing to guard" >&2; exit 0; fi'

bash -c 'IN=$(cat); H=.claude/hooks/pre-stop-gate.sh; C=$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r ".cwd // empty"); R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -f "$R/$H" ] || R=$(git -C "$C" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$R/$H" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$R" bash "$R/$H"; elif [ -n "$C" ] && git -C "$C" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "pre-stop-gate: hook script unresolvable inside a repo — gate did not run" >&2; exit 1; else echo "pre-stop-gate: cwd outside any git repo — nothing to guard" >&2; exit 0; fi'
